description: AMT Moment is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. An AMT moment is a moment during which the Day-ahead Price is equal to or exceeds the AMT-price. ELIA determines the AMT Price for Delivery Period 𝑌 based on the latest reference scenario defined in the of Royal Decree “Methodology” to set the Auction Parameters for the 𝑌−1 Auction applying to Delivery Period 𝑌. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Adequacy. Its keywords are AMT MTU, Availability Monitoring Trigger. The portal shows 2026-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
